summary: P2 backend testing complete. 14/17 pytest cases passed, 3 skipped due to a real backend auth bug: non-admin seeded users (*@cvln.local) cannot login because pydantic EmailStr rejects the .local TLD as a special-use reserved name (HTTP 422). Admin login works. All new P2 endpoints (discover-all, runtime/state, runtime/state/override for admin, events emit+verify+tamper, finance/loop 9 stages, people/loop 11 stages) work correctly. Light regression on command-center, registry, notarizations, contracts, adapters all pass. Registry has 12 repos, discover-all populates lifecycle_status+discovery_at on all 12.

critical.issue: LoginBody.email uses pydantic EmailStr; email-validator rejects `employee@cvln.local` (and cfo/hr/ops/legal @cvln.local) with 422 'The part after the @-sign is a special-use or reserved name that cannot be used with email.' This blocks ALL 5 non-admin seeded users from ever logging in, making role/RBAC flows untestable end-to-end (employee 403 checks, cfo/hr overview, etc).

minor.issue: When ping_history is empty in the last hour, `signals` is returned as an empty {} — spec says signals must always include {total_pings,error_rate,p95_ms,active_incidents}. Currently only guaranteed when there is data.
CASHFLOW stage uses `sum(...) or None` — if the aggregate legitimately equals 0 it will be reported as DATA_NOT_AVAILABLE. Use explicit None check on empty series instead.

Multiple GET endpoints return mixed shapes: /api/registry/repositories returns {repositories,count}, /api/notarizations returns {notarizations,notary,count,filters}, /api/contracts returns {contracts,count}. Consistent with a wrapper convention but should be documented — tests and clients cannot assume list.

_compute_runtime_mode uses `int(0.95 * total)` for p95 index — off-by-one when total is small; use statistics.quantiles or interpolation for correctness.
discover-all does synchronous _rq.get in asyncio.to_thread but sequentially across 12 repos — could take up to 12*6s=72s. Consider asyncio.gather.
Finance CASHFLOW: `sum([...]) or None` collapses valid 0 to None.

rca of the issue: RCA: /app/backend/server.py:107 defines `class LoginBody(BaseModel): email: EmailStr`. Pydantic v2 email-validator classifies `.local` as a special-use / reserved TLD per RFC 6761 and refuses it, returning HTTP 422 before the handler even runs. seed_data.py seeds five internal users with @cvln.local addresses (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md), so none of them can authenticate. Reproduce: curl -sS -X POST $URL/api/auth/login -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"email":"employee@cvln.local","password":"Cvln2026!"}' → 422. Mitigation options: (1) change `email: EmailStr` → `email: str` in LoginBody (login already validated against DB), (2) rename seeded emails to a non-reserved TLD, (3) monkey-patch email_validator to allow special-use domains. Option 1 is the least invasive.
